mohammedmr123/2D-run-and-gun.title: 2D Run and Gun
mohammedmr123/2D-run-and-gun.description: A 2D action platformer and run-and-gun game developed in Unity with C#, featuring responsive character movement, projectile weapon mechanics, and dynamic enemy encounters.
mohammedmr123/2D-run-and-gun.imageAlt: 2D retro arcade action platformer run-and-gun gameplay with hero jumping, shooting lasers, and battling robot drones

mohammedmr123/TankBattle.title: Tank Battleground
mohammedmr123/TankBattle.description: A top-down 3D tank combat shooter built in Unity 6 LTS featuring wave-based AI enemy encounters, custom turret aiming, vehicle physics, audio, and visual effects across 3 arenas.
mohammedmr123/TankBattle.imageAlt: Top-down 3D tank combat shooter gameplay in Unity featuring battle tanks, explosive projectiles, and arena warfare
